title: Reverse Pairs (nums[i] > 2 * nums[j])

monster.name: Doubling Hydra
monster.title: Harvester of Significant Inversions
monster.defeatQuote: Count of index pairs (i < j) where nums[i] > 2 * nums[j] computed!

description: Given an integer array `nums`, return the number of reverse pairs in the array. A reverse pair is a pair `(i, j)` where `0 <= i < j < nums.length` and `nums[i] > 2 * nums[j]`.
solutionCode:
def reversePairs(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    import bisect
    seen = []
    count = 0
    for x in nums:
        # count elements in seen that are > 2 * x
        idx = bisect.bisect_right(seen, 2 * x)
        count += len(seen) - idx
        bisect.insort(seen, x)
    return count

python.solutionCode:
def reversePairs(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    import bisect
    seen = []
    count = 0
    for x in nums:
        # count elements in seen that are > 2 * x
        idx = bisect.bisect_right(seen, 2 * x)
        count += len(seen) - idx
        bisect.insort(seen, x)
    return count
